command: terraform plan -target=aws_instance.gw -lock=false -input=false -no-color -var market_update_s3_root=<lib/opal_naming.py address() output>; no -out; nothing applied
downtime_behaviour: AWS stops the instance, changes the type, and starts it: the gateway is DOWN for every user for the whole stop/start; the Elastic IP stays associated, so the public address does not change
expected_downtime: UNKNOWN, not measured: no stop/start of this instance has been recorded (the host reads up 31 days); a t4g stop/start is typically minutes, to be measured in Phase B (first failed health read to first 200)
plan_file_note: the full plan text holds the public address and DNS name and is kept off-repo; this record holds counts and attribute names only

tf_change.why_on_a_branch: so an untargeted apply of this Terraform root by another seat cannot resize the live gateway before the signed window; Phase B applies this blob targeted at aws_instance.gw
